question: What fierce recitation may be performed for afflictions in the bodies of the king or others?
premises: The king’s body may be afflicted.
The bodies of other men may be afflicted.
A fierce recitation is prescribed as a remedy.
inference: For afflictions in the body of the king or of other men, one should perform a fierce recitation.
uncertainties: The repetition of dehe is preserved as in the transmitted text.
plain_english: Or one should perform a fierce recitation for the body of the king and for the bodies of men.
